canonical_name: Improvements Not Identified from Security Tests and Exercises
description: Improvements are not identified from security tests and exercises.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of post-exercise analysis, lack of documented findings from penetration tests or tabletop exercises, failure to capture lessons learned from supplier security assessments, or missing action items following security testing activities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
